Name: Kichi's Birch Single Bed
Author: kichisowseri
Description:
Replaces the default single bed with a birch one that's a bit taller to match the dresser. 
Designed for the default beach farm aesthetic with birch furniture, based on the vanilla Birch Double Bed.
Affects all single default beds, but does not affect the children's beds.
